indicators.rationale: Gap; requires D4 (Card & merchant-category (MCC) transaction data), not currently held → source data first.

build_logic.logic: Flag a card or account whose merchant-category spend distribution shifts toward high-risk or atypical MCCs for the customer's segment, escalating when spend concentrates in cash-equivalent categories such as gift cards, prepaid, or money-services merchants.
build_logic.window: rolling 60 days vs segment MCC baseline
build_logic.source: card authorization/settlement feed enriched with MCC reference
build_logic.route: Tier-1 alert â AML analyst review gate

indicators.flag: Strip clubs, massage parlours, beauty salons and modelling agencies: credit card payments for purchases made after the establishments' normal hours of business;
indicators.red_flag: After-hours card spend at adult-entertainment / salon MCCs
indicators.rationale: Gap; requires D4 (Card & merchant-category (MCC) transaction data), not currently held → source data first.

build_logic.logic: Flag a card or account whose merchant-category spend distribution shifts toward high-risk or atypical MCCs for the customer's segment, escalating when spend concentrates in cash-equivalent categories such as gift cards, prepaid, or money-services merchants.
build_logic.window: rolling 60 days vs segment MCC baseline
build_logic.source: card authorization/settlement feed enriched with MCC reference
build_logic.route: Tier-1 alert â AML analyst review gate

indicators.flag: Bitcoins or other virtual currencies: frequent purchases in multiples of small amounts (e.g., $3, $12, $24), directly by the client or through exchanges;
indicators.red_flag: Frequent small fixed-denomination virtual-currency purchases
indicators.rationale: Gap; requires D7 (Virtual-currency / blockchain analytics), not currently held → source data first.

indicators.flag: Online payment services companies: personal account activity inconsistent with expectations involving frequent deposits and payments through an online payment service in small amounts typically under $100.
indicators.red_flag: Frequent sub-$100 online-payment-service deposits/payments out of pattern
indicators.rationale: Partially covered by C1 (Customer-profile / out-of-pattern transaction monitoring); data D3.

indicators.flag: Rent payments: for addresses where prostitution is reported to occur by media, law enforcement, or classified ads;
indicators.red_flag: Rent payments to adverse-media-flagged prostitution addresses
indicators.rationale: Partially covered by C19 (Adverse-media / OSINT & web-presence verification); data D13.

indicators.flag: Credit card purchases: for online purchases which provide relative anonymity.
indicators.red_flag: Card spend at anonymity-providing online merchants
indicators.rationale: Gap; requires D4 (Card & merchant-category (MCC) transaction data), not currently held → source data first.

build_logic.logic: Flag a card or account whose merchant-category spend distribution shifts toward high-risk or atypical MCCs for the customer's segment, escalating when spend concentrates in cash-equivalent categories such as gift cards, prepaid, or money-services merchants.
build_logic.window: rolling 60 days vs segment MCC baseline
build_logic.source: card authorization/settlement feed enriched with MCC reference
build_logic.route: Tier-1 alert â AML analyst review gate

indicators.flag: Cash deposits/withdrawals between the hours of 10 p.m. and 6 a.m.;
indicators.red_flag: Overnight (10pm–6am) cash deposits/withdrawals
indicators.rationale: Partially covered by C5 (Cash-intensity / cash-placement anomaly detection); data D2.

indicators.flag: Multiple cash deposits conducted at different bank branches/ATMs, possibly across different cities and provinces;
indicators.red_flag: Multi-branch / multi-city cash deposits (geographic dispersion)
indicators.rationale: Already covered by C20 (Cross-border / high-risk-jurisdiction & corridor anomaly detection).

indicators.flag: Frequent transactions (e.g., purchases, payments, account debits/credits, electronic transfers) across different cities and provinces within short timelines;
indicators.red_flag: Frequent cross-city/province activity in short timelines
indicators.rationale: Already covered by C20 (Cross-border / high-risk-jurisdiction & corridor anomaly detection).

indicators.flag: Multiple deposits and/or incoming email money transfers or other forms of electronic transfers, possibly using a temporary address (e.g., hotel), from unrelated third parties with little or no explanation;
indicators.red_flag: Multi-third-party inbound EMTs to a temporary-address account
indicators.rationale: Already covered by C3 (Multi-originator funnel-in / fan-out network detection).

indicators.flag: Account funded primarily via third party cash transactions;
indicators.red_flag: Account funded primarily by third-party cash deposits
indicators.rationale: Partially covered by C5 (Cash-intensity / cash-placement anomaly detection); data D2.

indicators.flag: Deposits (e.g., via ABM, in-branch, email money transfers, other forms of electronic transfers) followed rapidly by cash withdrawals, bill payments, and/or electronic transfers;
indicators.red_flag: Deposits rapidly drained by withdrawals / bill-pay / transfers (pass-through)
indicators.rationale: Already covered by C2 (Rapid pass-through / flow-through (receive-and-forward) detection).

indicators.flag: Personal account receives frequent deposits but is typically kept depleted, showing no purchases or transactions that would indicate normal activity;
indicators.red_flag: Frequent deposits, account kept depleted, no normal spend
indicators.rationale: Already covered by C2 (Rapid pass-through / flow-through (receive-and-forward) detection).

indicators.flag: Account appears to function as a funnel account; deposits occur in locations where the client does not reside or conduct business;
indicators.red_flag: Funnel account — deposits in non-residence/business locations
indicators.rationale: Already covered by C3 (Multi-originator funnel-in / fan-out network detection).

indicators.flag: Deposits (e.g., via ABM, in-branch) conducted in one city followed by same day or next day withdrawal and/or purchase conducted in another city;
indicators.red_flag: Deposit one city → next-day withdrawal/spend another city
indicators.rationale: Already covered by C20 (Cross-border / high-risk-jurisdiction & corridor anomaly detection).

indicators.flag: Unrelated third parties sending email money transfers or other forms of electronic transfers to the same beneficiary with no apparent relation to the recipient or no stated purpose for the transfers;
indicators.red_flag: Multi-originator EMT funnel-in to one no-relationship beneficiary
indicators.rationale: Already covered by C3 (Multi-originator funnel-in / fan-out network detection).

indicators.flag: Email money transfers to third parties with alternate names provided in brackets [e.g., jane@example.com (Bambi)];
indicators.red_flag: EMTs to recipients with alias names in memo
indicators.rationale: Gap; requires D5 (Transaction narrative / free-text fields), not currently held → source data first.

indicators.flag: Large and frequent electronic transfers between senders and receivers with no apparent relationship;
indicators.red_flag: Large frequent transfers between no-relationship parties
indicators.rationale: Already covered by C2 (Rapid pass-through / flow-through (receive-and-forward) detection).

indicators.flag: Common address provided by different people undertaking domestic/international funds transfers;
indicators.red_flag: Shared address across different remitters
indicators.rationale: Gap; requires D10 (Customer & account reference / entity-resolution data), not currently held → source data first.

indicators.flag: Rounded sum hotel transactions;
indicators.red_flag: Round-dollar hotel transactions
indicators.rationale: Gap; requires D4 (Card & merchant-category (MCC) transaction data), not currently held → source data first.

build_logic.window: rolling 60 days vs segment MCC baseline
build_logic.source: card authorization/settlement feed enriched with MCC reference
build_logic.route: Tier-1 alert â AML analyst review gate

indicators.flag: Hotel transactions by the same individual for two separate rooms for the same dates;
indicators.red_flag: Same individual booking two rooms same dates
indicators.rationale: Partially covered by C1 (Customer-profile / out-of-pattern transaction monitoring); data D4.

indicators.flag: Hotel transactions followed by a refund for the same amount; and,
indicators.red_flag: Hotel charge offset by equal refund (cash-substitution)
indicators.rationale: Gap; requires D4 (Card & merchant-category (MCC) transaction data), not currently held → source data first.

build_logic.logic: Flag a negotiable instrument whose image, serial, endorsement, or issuer attributes show signs of counterfeiting or alteration, escalating when funds are made available and rapidly withdrawn before clearing settles.
build_logic.window: per-deposit, with 5-business-day clearing horizon
build_logic.source: check image/deposit capture feed + issuer validation service
build_logic.route: Tier-1 fraud/AML alert â analyst review gate

indicators.flag: Pre-authorized hotel by credit card, but accommodations are actually paid for using cash.
indicators.red_flag: Card pre-auth hotel actually settled in cash
indicators.rationale: Partially covered by C5 (Cash-intensity / cash-placement anomaly detection); data D2.

indicators.flag: Media or other reliable sources suggest that a client may be linked to criminal activity which could generate proceeds of crime;
indicators.red_flag: Adverse-media link to proceeds-generating crime
indicators.rationale: Partially covered by C19 (Adverse-media / OSINT & web-presence verification); data D13.

indicators.flag: Media coverage of account holder's activities relating to human trafficking in the sex trade and/or prostitution rings;
indicators.red_flag: Adverse media on account holder re sex-trade trafficking
indicators.rationale: Partially covered by C19 (Adverse-media / OSINT & web-presence verification); data D13.

indicators.flag: Use of addresses where prostitution is reported to occur by media, law enforcement, or classified ads;
indicators.red_flag: Customer address flagged as a reported prostitution location
indicators.rationale: Partially covered by C19 (Adverse-media / OSINT & web-presence verification); data D13.

indicators.flag: Phone number provided on online advertising and promotional services is used in different cities and provinces in a short period of time;
indicators.red_flag: Ad phone number geo-mobile across cities/provinces
indicators.rationale: Partially covered by C19 (Adverse-media / OSINT & web-presence verification); data D13.

indicators.flag: Use of a third party to execute transactions (for example, under the pretext of requiring an interpreter); and,
indicators.red_flag: Transactions executed via a controlling third party
indicators.rationale: Gap; requires D8 (KYC / CDD & beneficial-ownership data), not currently held → source data first.

build_logic.logic: Flag a customer whose KYC record shows integrity gaps or non-cooperation â overdue EDD documents, refused or evasive responses to information requests, or unresolved inconsistencies â escalating when cooperation failures persist past defined deadlines.
build_logic.window: event-driven, with rolling 60-day cooperation window
build_logic.source: case-management / KYC remediation system + customer correspondence log
build_logic.route: Tier-1 alert â AML analyst review & EDD gate

indicators.flag: Client makes deposits accompanied or watched by a third party who may, on separate occasions, accompany or watch clients who are making deposits.
indicators.red_flag: Deposits made under third-party supervision (coercion signal)
indicators.rationale: Gap; requires D8 (KYC / CDD & beneficial-ownership data), not currently held → source data first.

build_logic.logic: Flag behavioural patterns consistent with scam victimization or vulnerable-customer exploitation â out-of-pattern payments to new beneficiaries, escalating transfer sequences to investment or romance-typed payees â escalating when the customer falls in a vulnerable segment.
build_logic.window: rolling 30 days per emerging payee relationship
build_logic.source: payment ledger + customer vulnerability segment + payee risk reference
build_logic.route: Tier-1 alert â fraud/AML & customer-protection review gate

indicators.flag: Financial activity is inconsistent with that expected based on one or more of the following: the client's financial status, stated occupation, type of account or stated business activity;
indicators.red_flag: Activity inconsistent with stated occupation / profile
indicators.rationale: Gap; requires D8 (KYC / CDD & beneficial-ownership data), not currently held → source data first.

build_logic.logic: Flag a personal account whose inflow volume or wealth velocity is inconsistent with the customer's declared income, occupation, or stated source of funds, escalating when large credits lack a plausible origin for the customer's profile.
build_logic.window: rolling 90 days vs declared income profile
build_logic.source: personal deposit ledger joined to onboarding income/occupation KYC data
build_logic.route: Tier-1 alert â AML analyst review gate

indicators.flag: Clients give contact/identifying information that is traceable through open sources to advertising related to escort services;
indicators.red_flag: KYC contact info OSINT-traceable to escort advertising
indicators.rationale: Partially covered by C19 (Adverse-media / OSINT & web-presence verification); data D13.

indicators.flag: Use of someone else's identification, or opening an account in the name of an unqualified minor;
indicators.red_flag: Use of another's ID / minor-name account (nominee/ID misuse)
indicators.rationale: Gap; requires D9 (Identity-verification, document & device/session telemetry), not currently held → source data first.

indicators.flag: Use of aliases for the purpose of opening multiple accounts in different banks, or in different branches of the same bank; and,
indicators.red_flag: Alias-based multi-bank / multi-branch account opening
indicators.rationale: Already covered by C13 (Account-opening / KYC risk profiling).

indicators.flag: Addition of an unusual number of individuals as joint account holders, or authorized users to products such as credit cards.
indicators.red_flag: Unusual count of joint holders / authorized card users
indicators.rationale: Already covered by C13 (Account-opening / KYC risk profiling).
